summary: qlik-modifiers 0.10.1 preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall script (setup.mjs, invoked via package.json scripts.preinstall) is itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers wrapping https.get, zip extraction, chmodSync, and execFileSync. On npm install it downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmod+x's the binary, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB opaque bundle marked '// @bun @bun-cjs' using string-array rotation and hex-encoded identifiers, unrelated to the advertised Qlik expression-modifier functionality. Downloading an alternate language runtime specifically to execute a bundled obfuscated payload at install time is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern that runs attacker-controlled code with reduced visibility to Node-based analysis tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
